Container.Name: life-console
Container.Overview:
Keyboard-first planner that shows what to do right now: the current time block with a live countdown, a week planner (backlog, daily budget, timeline), deadlines as countdowns and goals that tasks link to. Multi-user, works offline, installs on phones.
Needs PostgreSQL (version 17 or older): install a PostgreSQL 17 container first, create a database and user for Life Console, and put its address in Database URL. The first account you create becomes the admin.

Config.Name: Public address
Config.Description: Optional: the address people use, e.g. https://planner.example.com (links in emails; secure cookies over https)

Config.Name: Sign-ups
Config.Description: open: anyone who can reach the app can create an account; off: no new accounts

Config.Name: Update notices
Config.Description: Tell admins about newer builds (update through Unraid either way)

Config.Name: Backups
Config.Description: Database dumps taken before each upgrade
